# Security policy

This repository is the source for [claytoncunninghamdesign.com](https://www.claytoncunninghamdesign.com), a static portfolio site. It has no logins, forms, databases or user data.

## Reporting a vulnerability

If you find a security issue with the site or this repository, please report it privately using the contact listed in the site's [security.txt](https://www.claytoncunninghamdesign.com/.well-known/security.txt). Please don't open a public issue for it.

Include the affected page or file, what you found, and steps to reproduce. You'll get a reply as soon as possible.

## Supported versions

Only the live site (the `main` branch) is supported.
